_about: Largest box each media file is DRAWN in, in 1280x710 design px, derived 2026-11-04 from each part's styles.css (object-fit applied; the zoom panel is 660x660 contain in parts 02-04 and ~930x620 in parts 05-06; part 01 has no zoom). reencode-media.py resizes to 2 x the box (cover rule: the larger ratio), never upscales, skips a shrink under 10 %. Files absent here keep their size and are only re-encoded. `_video` boxes feed the clip re-encode (2 x box, even dimensions).
